mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month growth in real GDP signals a strengthening economy, increasing consumer and business confidence, which boosts equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE increases and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 2% within a month signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between INDPRO decreases and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When both real GDP and retail sales increase by more than 1% in the same quarter, it signals robust economic growth, boosting investor confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and RSAFS both increase > 1% in 1 quarter
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint effect of GDPC1 and RSAFS increases on SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.2% in the same month, it signals a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint effect of PAYEMS increase and UNRATE decrease on SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the consumer price index signals inflationary pressures, which can lead to monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in inflationary periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts by more than 10% within a month signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, which can lead to negative spillover effects on the broader economy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between HOUST decreases and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).
